exposure: Closure of the peritoneum at first caesarean section
Type of skin incision at first caesarean section
cohort: Women undergoing caesarean section in Ndala Hospital in 2011 and 2012
finding: Adhesions after caesarean sections were common, especially after midline skin incisions, but were not significantly associated with increased maternal morbidity or adverse neonatal outcomes in this low-income country setting.
